home.title: prefix™ (formerly pureskin)
home.description: prefix: the preventative fix for acne.
home.fit: **Consumable textile, not skincare — and the domain has rebranded.** trypureskin.com now serves prefixskin.com: 'pureskin is now pre·fix'. The product is a single-use cotton face towel sold on an acne-prevention argument (dirty reusable towels reintroduce bacteria and dead skin). There is no formulation and no active, so ingredient and routine hooks do not transfer. The acne framing makes its ad copy read as skincare, which is exactly why it needs tagging. Strong UGC product in its own right — the problem demo is vivid — but its own corpus, not the skincare one.
